common.noSessions: No sessions yet. Open a folder to start your first task.
common.composerPlaceholderRunning: Working  Enter to steer, Alt+Enter to follow up
common.sendNowHint: Stops the current work and sends right away
common.updateAskBody: This runs pi update on the server machine. Open sessions use the new version after a restart.
common.updatedRestart: Restart open sessions to apply it
common.updatedNew: New sessions use it from now on
common.chooseFolder: Choose a folder to work in
common.chooseFolderHelp: pi reads files and runs commands in this folder.
common.tokenTitle: A token or password is needed
common.tokenHelp: Enter the value after #token= in the address the server printed at start (the token), or the password set with --password.
common.tokenWrong: That did not match. Check it and try again. Too many wrong tries lock you out for a while.
common.tokenLocked: Too many tries. Try again in a little while.
common.serverUnreachable: No server answered at that address, so nothing was changed. Check the address and port.
common.serverThisPage: The server that opened this page
common.serverReset: Go back to the server that opened this page
common.serverDown: Cannot reach the server. Check that the pi-oven server is running.
common.emptyTitle: Where do you want to work?
common.emptyBody: Pick a folder and pi starts a new session there. You can also continue an earlier session from the list on the left.

ember.name: Ember
ember.hint: Appears glowing orange and cools to its own colour.

fx.title: How answers appear
fx.sample: An answer being written appears like this.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Language files live in web/src/locales. See the README there to add a language.
settings.thinkingOpen: Show thinking expanded while it is written
settings.notify: Notify me of finished work and questions when I am elsewhere

pins.title: Pin rules (regex)
pins.note: Besides the addresses and tokens the Pin tab finds on its own, add values you want found as regular expressions. With a group ( ) only the first group is pinned, otherwise the whole match. Found values are hidden like tokens (the eye icon shows them), and with Showcase "Tokens, passwords, API keys" on they are hidden in the chat too. Saved in this browser only.
pins.name: Name (e.g. company key)

models.title: Models
models.note: Add models from another server or API to pi: an endpoint address, a key and the model IDs.

showcase.title: Showcase mode
showcase.note: Hides things that may be sensitive when you share your screen or take screenshots. Only what is shown changes; what is saved or copied stays the same.

server.title: Server address
server.note: Usually left empty. Fill it in only to use the API of a server other than the one that served this page (a dev server, say). Logins are kept per server.
server.thisPage: The server that served this page
server.appNote: In the app, the server is chosen on its first screen.
server.signOutBody: This removes the token saved in this browser. To come back you will need the token or password again.

retry.title: API retries
retry.hint: After 3 failures, tries again every 60 minutes, up to 100 times. The server keeps going with this window closed.
retry.unavailable: Not available: the retry extension is not installed on this server.

settings.notifyBlocked: The browser blocks notifications, so only the tab title and a tone tell you. Allow notifications in the browser's site settings.
settings.notifyInsecure: Desktop notifications do not work on this address (HTTP), so only the tab title and a tone tell you. Open it over HTTPS or on localhost for desktop notifications.

meta.title: Under the message box
meta.limitsHint: Shown only for ChatGPT or Claude subscription models.

paths.label: Project folder paths
paths.hint: Blurs folder names and paths (list, header, info panel) and turns paths in the chat and output into <project>.

user.label: User name and home folder
user.hint: Turns parts like /home/name or C:\Users\name into ~ or user.

titles.label: Session titles and first messages
titles.hint: Blurs session titles in the list and header, and message previews in the tree.

secrets.label: Tokens, passwords, API keys
secrets.hint: Hides tokens and keys found in the chat and token= values in addresses, and the values in the Pin tab.

hosts.label: Server addresses and IPs
hosts.hint: Turns hosts into server and IPs into •.•.•.•, and blurs addresses in Settings and Models.

files.label: File names
files.hint: Blurs file names in the explorer, editor tabs and the Git and Diff lists.

chat.label: Chat text
chat.hint: Blurs all message and answer text (the strongest setting).

about.mcpNote: Tool counts are from the last time pi-mcp-adapter connected. Commands, addresses and keys are not shown.

sidebar.deleteInFolder: Delete several sessions in this folder…
sidebar.renameOpen: It is open right now, so it cannot be changed
sidebar.lockedHint: A session that has not been saved yet cannot be picked
sidebar.showcaseOn: Showcase mode is on. Click to open Settings.

app.drop: Drop here to open in the editor

picker.outside: This server works only inside one folder. Choose a folder within it.
picker.moveHelp: The conversation is copied into a new session that works in the folder you choose.

turn.rewindBody: You continue in a new session without this message and what came after. The original session stays as it was.
turn.noRegenImages: Messages with images cannot be regenerated

files.delDirBody: Everything in the folder is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
files.delFileBody: It is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
files.empty: This folder is empty. Use + above to make a file.
files.blocked: This link points outside the folder, so it cannot be opened
files.truncated: Too many entries; showing some of them.
files.hint: Drag a file to the middle or click it to edit. Drag it to the message box to insert its path.

git.notRepo: This folder is not a Git repository.
git.truncated: Too many files; showing some of them.
git.checkFirst: Check the files to commit first

diff.empty: Files pi changes show up here.
diff.followHint: Expands a file by itself when it is changed again
diff.bashNote: Files changed by bash are not here. See the Git tab.

point.notFound: Could not find this message in the chat
point.pinnedNote: Pin addresses, tokens or chat messages (the pin button under a message) you look at often and they stay here. Saved in this browser only.
point.name: Name
point.noUrls: None yet. Addresses a server prints are picked up by themselves.
point.local: An address on this PC, so it opens as {host}
point.noSecrets: Nothing found. Looks for values named like token, secret or key, and common key formats.

tree.title: Session tree

branches.one: There is {n} branch. The solid dots are the flow you are on.
branches.other: There are {n} branches. The solid dots are the flow you are on.

tree.linear: A single line with no branches. Pick a message to start a new flow from there.
tree.here: Open a new session up to here
tree.foot: The original session stays as it is; the conversation up to the point you pick is copied to a new session file and opened.

inspector.afterCompact: Not counted yet, right after compaction.

editor.label: File editor
editor.changedOnDisk: The file changed on disk. pi or another program may have edited it.
editor.deleted: This file was deleted on disk. Saving creates it again.

err.e415: Not a text (UTF-8) file, so it cannot be edited.
err.e413: The file is too large to open (over 2 MB).

editor.imageBroken: This image cannot be shown. The file is damaged or too large (up to 30 MB).

bg.title: Background tasks
bg.clearHint: Clears the finished and failed entries you have seen
bg.empty: No background tasks were started in this session. When pi starts a long command with bg_run it shows up here.

tool.showImage: Expand the tool result with an image

composer.ctxFile: Tells pi about this file with the message

manual.label: Manual
manual.hint: Asks before running commands or changing files.

transcript.intro: In this folder pi reads files, runs commands and edits code. Type your request below.

models.emptyList: The server sent an empty model list. Type the model ID yourself.
models.needProvider: Enter a provider name and address.
models.needModel: Enter a model ID. (Load from the server to pick one.)

delProviderBody.one: Removes {provider} and its {n} model from models.json, with its saved key.
delProviderBody.other: Removes {provider} and its {n} models from models.json, with its saved key.

models.editHint: Add more models to this provider or change its address
models.keyLocal: Any value for a local server (e.g. a)
models.keyNote: A plain value is saved in models.json. Forms pi reads, like $ENV_VAR or !command, work too.
models.modelIdPh: The model name sent to the server
models.visible: You can pick it in the open session's model list now.
models.notVisible: Open sessions do not show it yet. Reopen the session to see it in the list.
models.newSessions: It appears in the model list of sessions you open from now on.

rules.max: You can make up to {n} rules.
rules.long: The pattern is too long (200 characters at most).
rules.nested: Patterns with a repeat inside a repeat cannot be used, e.g. (a+)+

appmsg.delBody: The session file is deleted. This cannot be undone.

restartBusy.one: Restarted. Restart the {n} working session when it is done
restartBusy.other: Restarted. Restart the {n} working sessions when they are done

appmsg.unsavedBody: Closing the session loses the changes you were editing.
appmsg.network: Could not connect to the server.

delOpen.one: The open session is closed first.
delOpen.other: The {n} open sessions are closed first.

delOpenRunning.one: The open session is closed first, and its running work stops.
delOpenRunning.other: The {n} open sessions are closed first, and their running work stops.

appmsg.movedNote: This session's working folder moved from {from} to {to}. Paths earlier in the history refer to the old folder; work from the new one from now on.
appmsg.moveDelBody: The session is open in its new folder. Deleting the original file left in {folder} cannot be undone.
appmsg.moved: Session moved. The original is kept
appmsg.movedDeleted: Session moved and the original deleted
appmsg.moveBusy: Move it once the current run is done

slash.stats: {req} requests, {res} replies, {tools} tool calls, {tokens} tokens, cost ${cost}

unsupported.resume: Pick a session from the list on the left.
unsupported.fork: Use "Branch from here" on a message.
unsupported.tree: The session tree command is not supported on the web yet.
unsupported.settings: Change these settings in pi in a terminal.
unsupported.login: Log in with pi in a terminal.
unsupported.logout: Log out with pi in a terminal.
unsupported.trust: Decide project trust with pi in a terminal (or the server option --pi-arg=--approve).
unsupported.share: Not supported on the web. Use /export.

long.name: 100h mode
long.gaveUp: 100h mode: the request failed all 100 tries. Send a message to try again.

resume.name: Zero-Standby
resume.title: Plan limits
resume.hint: When the 5-hour limit stops a run, the message below is sent once it resets so the work carries on. Runs on the server, with every window closed.
resume.gaveUp: Zero-Standby: the limit was still hit after resetting, so it stopped.
resume.tipWindow: Sent when the {window} limit resets at {clock}
resume.tip: Sent when the limit resets at {clock}
resume.tipGuess: Reset time unknown: tries in an hour
resume.skippedLong: The {window} limit was hit. It resets {date}, too far off for Zero-Standby to wait.

oven.applyNote: The server file from the GitHub release is checked against SHA256SUMS, put in place, and the server starts again with the same arguments. pi in open sessions restarts too.
oven.restarting: Restarting… the page reloads when the server is back.
oven.notBack: The server did not come back as the new build within 90 seconds. Check the server itself.
oven.autoHint: The server checks the GitHub release every 6 hours and shows a notice under the list when there is a new build.
oven.askBody: It switches to the new build and starts again with the same arguments. pi in open sessions restarts too, and the page reloads once the server is back.
